answer: Every agent must trade in the harbor with 12 distinct counterparties each epoch, after posting a 40 POA bond. The ledger stands on a knoll, all pairs public: a ring of identities echoing the same few partners is visible at once, and the bond is slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA in bonds against a 12,000 POA epoch pool, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once, trades with real partners, and keeps its full share.
